scope: Read-only current-code audit and implementation proposals. No production or DB edits. No pipeline execution or generator reruns. Existing tests were inspected selectively, not run. Root covers donor/selection algorithm; separate workstream covers report acceptance.

current_flow.behavior: Capture immutable-basis imported target/context evidence and separate current inventory; exclude retired and multipart-contained sources.
Select complete imported donor snapshot, derive coverage/completeness, ask investigator for account and optional exactly-three exemplars; currently publish examples immediately.
Resume author across bounded attempts, preserve prior findings, create package manifest; unsupported/blocked is routed to repair unless budget is exhausted.
Build samples all three bands, lower raw count only through package-declared finite caps, run each seed twice, bind output/assets/dependencies; refill samples one band.

Check accepted binding; publish immutable package; compare fresh instructional source; deduplicate and apply specific policies; commit exact durable intent; verify receipt/readback.

Require valid immutable package/source/all-band approval; no model session; generate requested band, filter/publish, and confirm pool replenishment on a later inventory capture.

same_three_agent_proposal: Keep the same investigator, author and verifier. The investigator writes local target objective/progression account plus only needed draft anchors, bound to exact target and donor evidence.
The author builds from that account, preserving the learner’s target decisions. Declared limitations explain legitimate finite scope rather than forcing cosmetic numeric variants.

The existing verifier independently reconstructs the objective, may revise mistaken assumptions/findings, checks final examples and all required band batches including delivered subsets, then finalizes one evidence envelope and package.
Only then prepare and publish the approved normal questions and generator; exact durable-intent recovery remains first priority after a crash.

Fast refill retains the previous pedagogical approval, runs bounded behavioral checks on its new filtered exposure set, and reports finite exhaustion or a concrete new failure without silently changing curriculum.

evidence.code: Ordinary practice must preserve the mathematical decisions, method selection, and formula recall required by the target KP's standalone source questions at every difficulty. Make easy variants manageable through simpler expressions, coefficients, coordinates, and arithmetic without supplying those decisions or their intermediate results. Keep procedural reminders, formulas to recall, substituted setups, and intermediate calculations in the worked solution. Prompt support is justified only when the target's source question supplies that support for the same objective and practice stage; a tutorial, worked solution, or unrelated reference KP does not establish that permission. A missing easy anchor is not permission to turn independent practice into a guided exercise. Compare what the learner must do before feedback, including answer-choice cues, and correct existing exemplars that violate this rule rather than treating their publication as instructional authority.

recommended_order: ORCH-01 and ORCH-02: close premature publication and stale evidence reuse together.
ORCH-03: bind a revisable instructional account and clear source/donor boundaries.
ORCH-04 and ORCH-05: address quota/capacity pressure without silently changing the three-band product policy.
ORCH-06: connect approved behavior to actual refill exposure; coordinate with selection audit.
ORCH-07: explicit finding supersession; ORCH-08: active-review environment consistency.
preserve_existing_safeguards: Imported target evidence is separated from generated inventory; do not contaminate source truth with agent exemplars.
Immutable content-addressed packages, assets, source and exact batch bindings.
No overwriting served questions; exact durable request/receipt recovery before changing intent.
All-band review/progression checking under the current product policy.
Persistent investigator/author/verifier sessions with bounded launches, report corrections and explicit resumes.
Incomplete imported fields are observations, not mandatory pool repair work.
Current instructional prompts already protect target decisions and allow evidence-based correction of earlier assumptions.
No blanket pedagogical re-review on ordinary engine rebuilds.
non_claims: Current code paths are enabling risks; this audit does not infer hidden agent motives.
Pre-review examples are NOT relabeled as imported Math Academy evidence: current source filtering correctly prevents that.
The historical 1,382-event evidence retry issue is substantially mitigated by current durable budgets and report-only routing.
All-band coverage is an explicit present policy; changing that policy requires a conscious product decision, not an implementation shortcut.
No generic rank/balance/quota test can by itself establish pedagogical validity; the rank-inspection reversal demonstrates why.
